clips.title: The story
paras: The Scourge holds the Agamand Family Crypt just north of Agamand Mills. It was the ancient resting ground of one of Tirisfal's wealthiest farming dynasties, but Captain Dargol has opened its tombs and raised the ancestors as mindless terrors.

The Agamand family once held broad estates across northern Tirisfal Glades, and buried their ancestors in this hillside crypt. The Plague ruined the kingdom, and Captain Dargol, an agent of the Scourge, seized the tombs. Through dark necromancy, he awakened the Agamand dead as vengeful skeletons and apparitions. Their restless forms now make the family burial ground a Scourge foothold beside Forsaken territory.
